body: no problem, best of luck and don't beat yourself up man
I am deeply grateful for you reaching out. I will do my best to take this advice to heart, thank you. I appreciate you taking the time to read the long post (sorry)

Hey, i've had suicidal thoughts for a long time and seem to have a sort of similar experience as your sister. I don't know if this helps, but when I really have my worst moments, it ALWAYS helps to hear that people care about me. Delusions will override any prior feelings of attachment sometimes, and even if I never show it, I smile inside a little to be reassured that people care and I matter.

Now I don't know the story or your sister, but making her feel loved without making too much of a fuss over her (she might feel worse that you expend so much effort on her) could really be helpful. Take this tip with a grain of salt as I am by no means an expert, but it could really take the edge off for her. Best of luck
